title: Research: screen selected rank-two macro fusion
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Screens direct fusion of two successive rank-one frame climbs into a selected rank-two child recipe in the pinned complex provider. If the composition were exact, the recursive charge of two rank-one calls would fall by the factor 2^-a for a > 0.

Each orientation has 2,412 rank-one climbs and 1,441 successive same-register links. Thirty-five links have a matching rank-two recipe for their combined endpoint frames. Every one of those 35 candidates has intervening scalar work on the same register (10 with one touch, five with two, 20 with five). No pair can be replaced directly while preserving the recorded scalar schedule.

Linearity suggests moving a post-add climb to the add's source operand. Across all 100 candidate/add-operand instances, none of those source registers already receives the exact same rank-one frame transition anywhere in the trace. The simple route that reuses an existing matching call is therefore absent too.

This is a scoped negative result for direct pair replacement and same-key call reuse, not a no-go theorem for redesigned macrocircuits. Matching endpoint frames does not prove that a rank-two child equals two rank-one children plus the intervening operations. No new supplier, exact macro equivalence or κ improvement is claimed; selected κ remains 0.001672660197076918.

## Task and overlap

Base: freshly fetched canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`. Task `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, **changed scope** to a bounded selected-source feasibility screen for direct rank-two pair fusion. The original construction and five-percent acceptance gates remain unmet.

The latest keyword overlap refresh covered 681 open PRs and 2,580 Discussions with complete pagination. A targeted local read found close related work missed by the query: [PR #1836](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1836), exact head `0a62e3f1c0ea493ddb83f25b91c5548c87978bcc`, and its [`complex-heterogeneous-child-interface` audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/main/research/complex-heterogeneous-child-interface/README.md) study simultaneous unequal-rank climbs, pairing into one higher-rank child, and reciprocal-encoding limits; that audit includes a 215-pair selected-source census. This PR instead screens successive rank-one climbs on one register with intervening scalar operations, including a search for same-key add-operand reuse. The results are complementary and the novelty claim is limited to that sequential contract. The [two-invocation stage-pair audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/main/docs/research/stage-pair-audit.md) studies another bit-side graph. Exact source archive, canonical word and child recipes are pinned; the verifier has no pending-PR dependencies.

## Validation

On CPython 3.12, the registered normal and optimized package replays passed:

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-rank2-macro-fusion-screen --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-rank2-macro-fusion-screen
```

The replay checks both orientations, exact source/member pins, every climb and scalar-frame transition, all candidate endpoint-recipe matches, the same-key operand census, and wrong-rank and removed-recipe controls. Publication-byte and source-history checks passed for commit `93157ab23657fb5f33751c5f858e81568caaec4b`. No complete supplier replay or Lean proof is claimed.

## Credit

Credit Cinna Davis / PR #1836 and Adam Gall's `complex-heterogeneous-child-interface` package for the simultaneous unequal-rank census and reciprocal-encoding classification; credit the selected PR #1094 provider lineage and its pinned source audit. Prepared by Gonzalo Mier with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed.

## Open next questions

The next exact test is the forward phase-B candidate on register 195 (event indices 12806 and 13402, transition 0→2→252, with one same-register touch `add L195, L521`). Reconstruct its full intervening region and child maps, test equality with the direct rank-two recipe on a complete exact basis, and price every changed register and restoration. See `TASK.json` for the blocker and stopping rule.
